title: reviews.aggregates_export
description: Cursor-paged snapshot of every target's rating aggregate — the source_of_truth half of a host rating Projection, read by stapel_core.comm.projections rebuild() and drift_check(). Response: {"rows": [{"target_key", "target_type", "avg", "count", "seq"}], "cursor": string|null, "total": integer|null}. `seq` is the newest updated_at among the target's published reviews in unix milliseconds — the same clock as an Event timestamp, so a live fact arriving mid-rebuild supersedes the snapshot row. `total` is reported on the first page only. Paging is keyset over (target_type, target_key), so the snapshot stays stable under concurrent writes.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation token from the previous page's `cursor`. Null/absent starts at the beginning.

limit.description: Rows per page. Absent/null means 500; values above 2000 are clamped.
